notes.title: It's a Whole New Ball Game
notes.content:
We did it. We release the full version of VReakout. And you won't be disappointed with all the new stuff we crammed in there. Power-ups, crazy challenges and levels, physics craziness, new music and awefull visual effects.

3 Levels of game difficulty.

So much more.

Make sure to add this game to your Vive exercise routine.

notes.title: One small step for us, one GIANT UPDATE for you!
notes.content:
We spent all weekend crunching out a major update.

First, there is a ton more eye candy! 

You now throw meteors with your right hand and comets with your left. This will turn into more fun challenges later.

Now, each wave has its own planetary environment.

And, you can SAVE YOUR PROGRESS after each wave. 

And jump to whichever waves are completed.

You can choose the size of the arena for increased difficulty.

You're also now standing on a platform, so there is a little less to freakout over.

The scoreboard has been moved to the platform so it's more convenient and easier to see.

Also, when your time is running out you'll be sucked into the Black Hole. This part is a work in progress, but you'll get the point.

Other stuff: random comets, space station, space vehicles, and a GIANT LAVA PLANET finale!

New promo video and screenshots are on the way!

Check it out!

Thanks, 
Team Animate Objects

notes.title: Fix for launching in SteamVR
notes.content:
Hey VReakers!

We noticed that there was an issue with launching inside of SteamVR. The game worked fine if you launched from the desktop or Steam client. But crashed if you lauched inside of SteamVR. I think we fixed the problem now.

We only changed a launch option but if it still doesn't work, simply try uninstalling and reinstalling.

Thanks,
Team Animate Objects
